accommodation.metaDesc: Discover unique rooms and suites at Halcyon House with king-size beds, antique furniture, and private balconies or terraces for a luxurious stay at Cabarita Beach.

Each guest room and suite at Halcyon House has been individually designed by interior designer Anna Spiro in her signature eclectic style. Halcyon House rooms feature antique furniture, fabric upholstered walls, luxurious king size beds and a private balcony or terrace.
